item.description: - **Attachments open in Quick Look:** Clicking an attachment in the composer now opens it straight in Quick Look, zooming out of its tile. Right-click a tile for Quick Look, Markup and Remove; Markup grows the tile straight into the drawing tools, and Done or Cancel sends it back. - **A cleaner card on iPhone and iPad:** Tapping an attachment grows it in one smooth move into the middle of the screen, with its name, kind, size and upload status above it and Quick Look, Markup and Remove as glass buttons below. - **Images side by side in the conversation:** Pictures you send and images an agent shows now sit in a row that scrolls sideways, matching the composer's attachment tiles, and the conversation keeps its place as they load.

- **Attachment cards come out of the shelf:** Clicking or tapping an attachment now lifts its picture straight up out of the composer, curves it toward the middle and grows it into shape as it rises, with its details joining it near the top. Closing sends it back the way it came. The conversation behind stays lightly blurred instead of frosted, and on iPhone a soft tap marks the card settling into place. - **Sharper attachments:** Wide screenshots and other pictures no longer look blurry in the composer's attachment tiles, and the card opens at full resolution from the start. - **Smoother markup:** Opening Markup no longer flickers as the drawing tools take over, the Done button stays steady while it saves, and iPhone plays a success tap when your markup is saved. - **Reduce Motion:** With Reduce Motion on, attachment cards and markup fade in place instead of moving. - **Resume after usage limits:** A chat paused by a provider's usage limit continues on its own after the limit resets, and **Cancel Auto-Continue** stops only that. The Usage page shows saved Pi and OpenCode subscriptions' quotas. - **Agent tools:** Claude Code takes changes to a chat's tool access without restarting its session, and Controller's tool server speaks the current MCP revision.

- **Attachment shelf:** Images, videos, PDFs and documents in the composer now sit side by side as small tiles shaped like what they hold: a picture at its own aspect, a video's first frame, a document's first page. Click one and it grows into a larger preview with its name, type, size and actions. Choose **Markup** to draw on an image or a PDF with Apple's markup tools, and the marked-up copy takes the original's place. **Quick Look** opens any attachment the system can preview, including spreadsheets, documents and videos. The same shelf, card and markup come to the iPhone app. - **Files on this Mac's threads:** Videos and other files can now be attached to chats on this Mac as well as on other Macs, and they can be dropped anywhere on the composer, including over the text. - **Projects from any Mac's home folder:** Devices on your account can add a project from a Mac's home folder and make changes to files there. A Mac shares its home folder with your devices by default; turn it off in **Settings › Connect › Hosting**. The Files panel now also works on another Mac's chat. - **Context pressure:** Claude chats warn before an automatic compaction, and the context meter estimates when the prompt cache goes cold. - **Background work stays visible:** A chat whose agent has paused while background agents or processes are still running keeps its latest work expanded until they finish. - **Agent connections:** Antigravity has its own connector, and Controller's tools for Cursor and Droid now share one local server instead of starting one per chat. - Fixes to model chip alignment and the slash-command menu on iPhone.
